term: able to be (source capacity; modal possibility of actuality)
resolution: CanBe keeps its IX.6 sense in the potency reading. ModalCapacity is a separate open premise connecting it to accessible actuality, and the fork in RootExposure keeps its failure as an option. On the denial, a respect can be true at an alternative without the being's having any ability to be so at the actual world, so immutability is not a modal claim about alternatives. No result says which is right.
